mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment; ganciclovir may increase gentamicin levels by reducing renal clearance, elevating risk of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) closely; consider alternative antiviral agents if possible; adjust gentamicin dosing based on creatinine clearance; assess baseline and periodic hearing function.
